#	system.perspective.print("building chart Data")
	usePackageCount = self.view.custom.usePackageCount
	#displayOptions = self.params.values.displayOptions
	metrics = {'targetCount': 0, 'infeedCount': 0, 'outfeedCount': 0, 'wasteCount': 0, 'infeedUnits': '', 'outfeedUnits': '', 'wasteUnits': '', 'targetRate': '', 'actualRate': '', 'rateUnits': 'hr', 'runtimeSecs': 0}
	infeedUnits = []
	outfeedUnits = []
	wasteUnits = []
	packageCount = []

	if value['data'] is None:
		self.custom.metrics = metrics
		return {}
	
	infeed = {}
	outfeed = {}
	waste = {}
	target = {}
	
	for row in value['data']:
		if row['infeedUnits']: infeedUnits.append(row['infeedUnits'])
		infeedCount = row['infeedCount'] or 0.0
		infeed[row['hourTimeStamp']] = infeed[row['hourTimeStamp']] + infeedCount if infeed.has_key(row['hourTimeStamp']) else infeedCount
		metrics['infeedCount'] += infeedCount
		
		if row['outfeedUnits']: outfeedUnits.append(row['outfeedUnits'])
		outfeedCount = (row['outfeedCount'] or 0.0) * (row['packageCount'] or 1.0) if usePackageCount else (row['outfeedCount'] or 0.0)
		outfeed[row['hourTimeStamp']] = outfeed[row['hourTimeStamp']] + outfeedCount if outfeed.has_key(row['hourTimeStamp']) else outfeedCount
		metrics['outfeedCount'] += outfeedCount

		if row['wasteUnits']: wasteUnits.append(row['wasteUnits'])
		wasteCount = row['wasteCount'] or 0.0
		waste[row['hourTimeStamp']] = waste[row['hourTimeStamp']] + wasteCount if waste.has_key(row['hourTimeStamp']) else wasteCount
		metrics['wasteCount'] += wasteCount
		
		targetCount = row['targetCount'] or 0.0
		target[row['hourTimeStamp']] = target[row['hourTimeStamp']] + targetCount if target.has_key(row['hourTimeStamp']) else targetCount
		metrics['targetCount'] += targetCount
		
		packageCount.append(row['packageCount'] or 1)
		
		metrics['runtimeSecs'] += row['runtimeSecs'] or 0

	data = {}
	data['infeed'] = [{"category": count[0], "value": count[1]} for count in sorted(infeed.items())]
	data['outfeed'] = [{"category": count[0], "value": count[1]} for count in sorted(outfeed.items())]
	data['waste'] = [{"category": count[0], "value": count[1]} for count in sorted(waste.items())]
	data['target'] = [{"category": count[0], "value": count[1]} for count in sorted(target.items())]
	
	infeedUnits = list(set(infeedUnits)) if len(infeedUnits) > 0 else ['']
	metrics['infeedUnits'] = infeedUnits[0] if len(infeedUnits) == 1 else 'mixed'
	
	outfeedUnits = list(set(outfeedUnits)) if len(outfeedUnits) > 0 else ['']
	metrics['outfeedUnits'] = outfeedUnits[0] if len(outfeedUnits) == 1 else 'mixed'
	
	wasteUnits = list(set(wasteUnits)) if len(wasteUnits) > 0 else ['']
	metrics['wasteUnits'] = wasteUnits[0] if len(wasteUnits) == 1 else 'mixed'
	
	packageCounts = list(set(packageCount)) if len(packageCount) > 0 else ['']
	metrics['packageCounts'] = packageCounts[0] if len(packageCounts) == 1 else 'mixed'
	
	metrics['targetRate'] = metrics['targetCount'] / (metrics['runtimeSecs'] / 3600.0) if metrics['targetCount'] > 0 and  metrics['runtimeSecs'] > 0 else 0
	metrics['actualRate'] = metrics['infeedCount'] / (metrics['runtimeSecs'] / 3600.0) if metrics['infeedCount'] > 0 and  metrics['runtimeSecs'] > 0 else 0
	
	self.custom.metrics = metrics
	return data

filters = dict(value)

if 'dark' in value: return 'dark'
